method: Read official public API reference, OpenAPI schema and webhook guide through the browser and its read-only documentation tools. No account, registration, provider API or fax request was made.
authentication: Bearer token issued for an API-enabled Spruce organization. Outgoing fax requires the reviewed internal endpoint of channel fax. The token and internal endpoint remain host-managed configuration, not a completed in-app account connection.

send.request: POST /v1/internalendpoints/{internalEndpointId}/conversations with destination.faxEndpoint and a message containing uploaded attachmentId.
send.acceptance: The returned requestId can match the requestId on conversationItem.created to identify when the message is posted. This is not fax transmission completion.
send.conversation_behavior: The official send guide says each outbound fax message from an internal endpoint creates a new fax conversation.
send.idempotency: s-idempotency-key is documented, up to 255 characters. HTTP 422 is documented as duplicate request. CosmaBot retains one operation and does not replay an ambiguous upload or fax mutation.

events.scope: All endpoint events belong to the owning organization. Bind the configured route, exact connection and accepted async request before creating a current-read reference.
events.signature: X-Spruce-Signature is Base64(HMAC-SHA256(exact raw body, endpoint secret)). The endpoint secret is returned only when an endpoint is created.
events.delivery: HTTPS endpoint must respond 2xx within five seconds. Events can arrive out of order. Spruce retries non-2xx delivery every two minutes for at most ten attempts.
events.implementation: Retain signed candidates with bounded correlation metadata. Duplicate exact bodies do not add another observation. Explicit inbound/internal signals cannot correlate to outgoing fax. Callback handling does not send, retry or perform automatic status reads.

current_item.checks: Exact item id and saved requestId, outbound direction, isInternalNote false, and no contradictory supplied object type.
current_item.pages: conversationItem.pages contains teammate paging entries (memberId, resolved, resolvedAt); it is not fax transmission page-count evidence.
current_item.events: conversationItem.event documents voice/video events; an answered outbound call does not prove a fax arrived.
current_item.limit: The current public schema contains no documented terminal fax transmission status. A validated item yields pending posting evidence only. No delivered/failed parser can be safely derived from this reference.

implementation_scope: Reviewed PDF custody, separate media-upload and fax-send approvals, accepted request, signed callback correlation, explicit current-item read, failure recovery and persistent receipts. Final fax delivery requires manual verification in Spruce. No receiving/downloading fax documents, cancellation, registration, account creation or live qualification.
qualification_still_required: API-enabled practice account and securely supplied bearer token
HTTPS callback route registered with Spruce and its signing secret securely installed
Controlled live approved upload and fax to an agreed test recipient
Documented terminal-delivery API evidence or manual confirmation in Spruce
